description: English wording for the coach's reasons. Slots: {name} inserts a value, {name:pct} a 0..1 share as a whole percent, {name:pct1} with one decimal, {name:signedPct1} a change with its sign (+2.1), {name:champion} a champion name, {name|one|many} picks the singular or plural word by the number in that slot. Numbers always come from the engine. axes/metrics give display names and number formats (percent, decimal, integer) for the playstyle card.

top:challenges.laneMinionsFirst10Minutes: Last-hit first, trade second: a lost wave costs more than a won trade.
Recall after crashing a wave into their tower, not mid-wave.
Use Teleport early to get back to lane fast and save the next wave.
top:earlyDeaths: Ward river or tri-brush before you push past the middle of the lane.
If you can't see the enemy jungler, assume they're near your lane.
Recall before you're too low to fight one more trade.
top:challenges.turretPlatesTaken: After a kill or their recall, hit the tower before you back.
Void Grubs speed up tower damage: join grubs when your wave is pushed.
top:challenges.controlWardsPlaced: Buy one control ward on your first back and put it in river or tri-brush.
jungle:challenges.jungleCsBefore10Minute: Finish your full clear before ganking unless a lane is clearly gankable.
Never walk past a camp that's up: take it on the way.
If a gank fails, go straight back to farm.
jungle:challenges.killsOnLanersEarlyJung: Gank when two hold: enemy pushed, no flash, no ward, your laner has CC.
Come from behind the enemy, not up the lane.
Gank at level 3, level 6 or right after your first item.
jungle:earlyDeaths: Track the enemy jungler: if you saw them top, path bot.
Don't invade without lane priority from the nearby laners.
jungle:challenges.wardTakedowns: Swap to sweeper once your early ganks are done.
Sweep the objective area before a fight.
jungle:challenges.controlWardsPlaced: Put a control ward on your side of the next objective.
middle:challenges.laneMinionsFirst10Minu: Shove the wave before you roam so you lose no minions.
Use the cannon wave timing to recall.
middle:earlyDeaths: Keep a ward on one side of mid and play toward it.
When their jungler is missing, stop pushing past half the lane.
middle:challenges.takedownsFirstXMinutes: Roam right after you push or kill your laner, never mid-wave.
Roam to lanes with CC or kill pressure; skip lanes that can't follow.
middle:challenges.turretPlatesTaken: After a kill or their recall, hit the tower before you back.
middle:challenges.controlWardsPlaced: Keep one control ward in a mid-lane side brush or river.
bottom:challenges.laneMinionsFirst10Minu: Under tower: let the tower hit melee minions twice, then last-hit.
Crash the wave before you recall.
bottom:earlyDeaths: Don't trade when their wave is bigger: minion aggro hurts.
Stand behind your minions against hooks and skillshots.
bottom:challenges.turretPlatesTaken: After a won fight or a dragon, hit plates before you back.
bottom:challenges.takedownsFirstXMinutes: Fight when your support's engage and your level spike line up.
utility:challenges.controlWardsPlaced: Buy a control ward on every back.
Place it where you'll fight next: dragon pit edge or river bush.
A control ward in your inventory gives no vision: place it.
utility:challenges.wardTakedowns: Swap to sweeper once your support item's quest is done.
Sweep before dragon, not during it.
utility:earlyDeaths: Ward from your side of the river, not deep and alone.
Roam only when your bot laner can stay safe without you.
utility:challenges.visionScorePerMinute: Wards in unwarded spots score more than wards next to others.
top:laneGoldDiffAt14: Trade when your wave is bigger than theirs.
Count plates: every plate is gold your opponent doesn't get.
middle:laneGoldDiffAt14: Trade when your wave is bigger than theirs.
Push first, then roam, so your opponent loses farm following you.
jungle:earlyEpicMonsterTakedowns: Ward the next objective a minute before it spawns.
Start dragon or grubs only when your nearby lanes can move first.
Keep Smite up for the objective.
bottom:laneCsDiffAt10: Hit them when they walk up to last-hit while your support zones.
utility:wardsPlacedBefore14: Use your support item's wards right away.
Ward river before the enemy jungler's first gank.
